T: The end of the world. The last of the snacks.
D: A group of actors are trapped in a Hollywood house party when the apocalypse hits.
P: Serve the sweets when they fight over the last chocolate bar.
S: Bruschetta with tomato and basil, the fancy party food before it all goes wrong. Toast slices of baguette, rub with garlic and top with 4 diced tomatoes, basil and olive oil.
Tinned and packet snacks shared out carefully: crackers, cheese and pretzels. Portion 200g crackers, 150g cheddar and 150g pretzels into equal piles for everyone.
M: Spaghetti with tinned tomatoes, garlic and chilli, apocalypse pantry cooking. Fry 3 garlic cloves and chilli in oil, add 800g tinned tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes.
W: the fight over the last chocolate bar
Homemade chocolate nougat and caramel bars, enough so nobody has to fight. Melt 200g marshmallows with 40g butter, press into a tin, top with 380g tinned caramel and chill.
K: Cold water in a jug with lemon, every drop shared.

s.how: Toast slices of baguette, rub with garlic and top with 4 diced tomatoes, basil and olive oil. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.
Portion 200g crackers, 150g cheddar and 150g pretzels into equal piles for everyone. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Fry 3 garlic cloves and chilli in oil, add 800g tinned tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes. Toss with 400g spaghetti and parmesan. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.note: the fight over the last chocolate bar
w.how: Melt 200g marshmallows with 40g butter, press into a tin, top with 380g tinned caramel and chill. Cover with 200g melted milk chocolate and cut into bars.

d.how: Fill a jug with ice, water and lemon slices and share it out. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
